# Maps, which Cyclone DDS 0.11 does not support, serialized by eProsima
# Fast CDR 2.3.3 (the serializer of Fast DDS 3.4) with fastcdr_maps.cpp: a
# FINAL struct
#   @final struct HoldMap { long p; map<long, string> m; map<long, long> pm; };
# with p = 7. Under XCDR2 the map of a non-primitive element carries a
# DHEADER, then the entry count, then the pairs; the map of primitives the
# count and the pairs (rule 14). Rule 15 of DDS-XTypes 1.3 7.4.3.5.3 shows
# no count after the DHEADER; Fast CDR writes one, as hddsgen does.
# `one`: m = {1: "a"}, pm = {3: 4}; `two`: m = {1: "a", 2: "bc"}, pm = {3: 4}.
one xcdr1 0700000001000000010000000200000061000000010000000300000004000000
one xcdr2 070000000e00000001000000010000000200000061000000010000000300000004000000
two xcdr1 0700000002000000010000000200000061000000020000000300000062630000010000000300000004000000
two xcdr2 070000001b00000002000000010000000200000061000000020000000300000062630000010000000300000004000000
